overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: although a quorum shared opinions and edited the letter outside a meeting, the letter only suggested ways to restructure Tri-Town meetings, which fell outside the Committee's jurisdiction.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee deliberated outside a posted meeting by drafting and sending a November 2020 letter to the three towns' Select Boards on Tri-Town meetings.
allegations.key_passage: Although this is a close call, we find that the communication is not within the Committee’s jurisdiction where the content of the November 12, 2020, letter simply suggested ways to restructure Tri-Town meetings.
